name: strong-note-refusal-reported
input: {"note": "Mrs. Keating declined her 6 pm walk, saying her hip was sore at a 3 out of 10. I reported it through the app at 6:10 and the nurse acknowledged. We did her seated stretches instead, both sets, toward her flexibility goal. Dinner at 6:45 was baked chicken and peas, three-quarters eaten. She was in bed at 9:30 per her wind-down routine goal.", "goals": ["Follow the evening wind-down routine and be in bed by ten", "Do seated stretches twice a day"]}
